name: Indicator Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Indicator Ventures (indicatorventures.com), an early-stage investment firm with offices in New York, Boston and Washington DC; general partners Jon Struhl (co-founder, New York), Geoff Bernstein (Boston) and Baiyin Murphy (Washington DC). SEC EDGAR lists its fund vehicles as Indicator Ventures, L.P., II, III, IV and Select I, all with Massachusetts addresses. Portfolio on the site includes Dandy, Databento, Beacon Biosignals, Makini and Retrocausal, matching round announcements that name 'Indicator Ventures'. Not Indicator Capital, not the Sao Paulo 'Indicator Fund 1, L.P.' in EDGAR, and not Index Ventures (whose AI deals dominate search results).

thesis_text.value: Early-stage firm backing founders at the idea stage, before a Series A, across healthcare, industrial automation, fintech and emerging tech. It leads, co-leads or joins rounds, writes $1-5M initial checks, and deliberately keeps a smaller portfolio so it can work closely with each company.

open_items: Fund sizes for Indicator Ventures III, L.P. (Form D 2021-12-27), Select I, L.P. (Form D 2021-03-05) and IV, L.P. (Form D 2025-12-04, Wellesley Hills, MA) not found. SEC EDGAR full-text search and submissions data accepted the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent, but the Form D documents themselves (www.sec.gov/Archives) returned 403, so offering amounts were not read. The site claims '$300M+ Assets under management', which implies Funds III-IV are much larger than Funds I-II.

Fund I ($16M, 2014) and Fund II ($25M, 2019) sizes come only from a database page (Value Add VC); no press release or firm announcement found. Exact final-close dates (the lead's 2014-11-12 and 2019-09-30) not confirmed; Form D filing dates are in the EDGAR search results.
No application form or apply URL: the site says to email a partner (first name @ indicatorventures.com) or the general contact address (not recorded). Cold inbound is stated as welcome.
Nothing found on investing in Indian founders or on requiring a US entity; every portfolio company found is US-based.

Partner sector focus not published; focus_sectors left empty. Jon Struhl led AudioShake's seed citing his audio-engineering background; venture partners Jacob Donoghue (CEO of portfolio company Beacon Biosignals) and Matthew Alkaitis (Beacon's Chief Clinical Officer) are physician-scientists; Marissa Grey is Head of Talent (Boston). Who covers Retrocausal or Makini is not stated.

The site lists 'Emerging Tech' as a sector and 'Vertical AI' and 'Commerce' as portfolio filters; these have no single sector id and were not mapped. A 2017 AlleyWatch interview described the firm as focused on 'emerging frontier technologies including VR/AR and machine learning'.

Industrial / supply-chain rounds sought but not recorded: Makini ('Universal industrial systems API') and RepRally ('Operating system for CPG distribution') are in the portfolio, but no fetched page names Indicator in a specific round (only database hints). Datalinx AI and SenseNet appear in database lists of Indicator deals, but their round pages do not name Indicator, so they were not recorded.

Other leads not checked for lack of search budget: Affiniti's $11M seed (Nov 2024; FinTech Futures names Indicator as a backer but no seed-round page was fetched), EDGE Markets' 2025 seed, Mara pre-seed (Aug 2026 per Caplight), Reflex seed, Netomi (Accenture Ventures investment, Apr 2026, does not name Indicator), Tacit, Dorothy, Polymer.
Beacon Biosignals Series B: Indicator is named among existing backers of the $86M round; the April 2026 extension to $97M added other investors only.
Lead about the NY Venture Summit 2026 attendee list was not checked; it adds no investment fact.
